facts.fact: Angop reports that Mbanza Kongo (Zaire) began civil registration of newborns with consequent attribution of the Bilhete de Identidade at a maternity post, under the nationwide EU-funded 'Nascer com Registo' project, running at the hospital since October 2025.
facts.system: Nascer com Registo / Bilhete de Identidade

systems.owner: Ministry of Justice and Human Rights

facts.fact: Angop reports newborn registration at the Mbanza Kongo maternity leads to issue of the first Bilhete de Identidade, under the Nascer com Registo project, since October 2025.
